[&amp;_summary]:text-xl"><p>We&#x27;re excited to share that Grok models are now natively available on Databricks Agent Bricks, Databricks&#x27; developer agent platform.</p>
<p>As part of the Databricks 2026 Data + AI Summit, Databricks is partnering with SpaceXAI to make Grok available alongside other frontier and open-source models in a single, governed platform.</p>
<p>Agent Bricks connects context (derived from data in Lakehouse) with control and choice, enabling engineering teams to effectively build AI agents that operate on large volumes of data.</p>
<p>Together with <a href="/news/grok-amazon-bedrock">Grok on Amazon Bedrock</a>, enterprises have more ways to run SpaceXAI models where their data already lives.</p>
<p>For more on Agent Bricks, see the <a href="https://www.databricks.com/blog/agent-bricks-dais-2026">Databricks announcement</a>.</p>
